answer: Each agent key binds to a utility smart meter that signs its hourly kWh reading; the ledger pays an identity only if its signed draw matches the inference load it claims, and one meter serial backs one key. A sybil running 500 clones on a single walnut-desk server has one meter, so its clones merge into one share; faking 500 means leasing 500 separately metered premises at real tariffs. A meter left idle cools like an ember, and an unsigned relic reading earns nothing.
